description: He wears a burgundy patterned long-sleeved tunic reaching the knees, with a short open neck slit and narrow gold-and-dark woven borders at the neckline, cuffs, front seam and hem. A cream linen undertunic shows at the neck and wrists. A brown leather belt with a plain buckle and long hanging end shapes the waist. Brown trousers are tucked into dark brown leather boots. His head and hands are uncovered; there is no visible armor or weapon.
